about: READ + ANNOTATE — re-measure what a push to the public GitHub mirror would publish, and write today's numbers onto the publish packet that is already open. Runs infra/forge/publish-github-pr.sh with --measure FIXED IN THE ARGV and no packet-supplied input at all: a rule that files this cannot file a publication, which is why the mode is a verb of its own rather than a word added to publish-github-pr's one_of (jobs.spawn carries no args list, so a rule-filed packet only ever gets a verb's default, and that verb's default is the publish). It makes the same two fetches a publish makes — forge main from the Forgejo repository on this host (a path, no forge credential) and the mirror's main anonymously (the repo is public) — reads no token, pushes nothing, opens no pull request, and ends by PATCHing drift_refresh + drift_refreshed_at onto the one open publish-to-github packet (commits ahead/behind, files changed, newly-public files with the runbook/infra ones named, the secrets verdict, both heads, the instant). Before that it asks GitHub's public pulls API (no credential) for the state of every publish PR not already read closed, and PATCHes the answer onto that PR's own packet as pr_state — the only place the publish region learns a PR merged (backlog a5d4322c: it called merged #239 open for 86 hours). The secrets scan is the published tree's OWN infra/lint/no-secrets.sh run over a throwaway worktree of forge main, so it scans what would actually leave the network; a finding is recorded for the reviewer, and a scan that cannot RUN answers `not yet` (75) having written nothing, because no evidence is not a pass. WHY IT EXISTS: publish-to-github-daily fires only on NOT open_publish_exists, so a packet held at its approve sign-off retired the cadence for every day behind it — the PII hold of 2026-09-17 -> 09-18 cost a week and PR #239 arrived as a 396-commit / 1319-file snapshot no reader and no CodeQL run can read as a change. Authorized by David 2026-09-19 in design cb38d806 (publishing to GitHub is smooth by 1.0.0), which decided that a held packet is refreshed rather than skipped; backlog e1b6ddf7. Filed by the dispatcher rule refresh-publish-drift-on-train-arrived when main moves and a publish packet is open. Timeout sized for two fetches plus a worktree checkout and a tree-wide lint. Pinned by crates/core/boss-testing/tests/publish_github_pr_sh.rs.
